name: 49608-multiimage-2b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, ~2.2B params: a 32-layer ViT (patch 14, 2x2 spatial merge, native resolution) over a 28-layer decoder; one 1024x1024 image becomes 1369 image tokens.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 20%, bounded at 200 requests with a 2400 s safety cap; 40 requests are discarded as warmup and 160 measured.
workload: single-turn image+text chat: one 32-token synthetic text prompt plus four distinct 1024x1024 JPEG images per request (quality 85, `content: noise`, seeds 49317-49320, fixed and mutually distinct so that no two of the run's 800 images are alike), 128 output tokens with `ignore_eos` at temperature 0.
purpose: A compact vision-language chat assistant answering four-image questions with short replies for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct

max-model-len: 8192

# The per-prompt image cap defaults to 1 at this version, so without this the four-image request
# is rejected outright.
# HAZARD: must stay inline JSON on ONE line. Written as an indented block mapping the key is
# dropped on the way to the engine and the cap silently reverts to 1.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 4}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85

tensor-parallel-size: 1

renderer-num-workers: 8

# Every one of the run's 800 images is distinct by construction (four independently seeded
# noise sources x 200 requests), so the processor cache can never hit. Off, so the run does not
# pay to hash and store 800 entries it will never read back.
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0
